ben.jones (Acme): Hey team — we're seeing a bunch of 401s from our backend after rotating keys this morning. Happened ~09:12 UTC. Started affecting batch jobs.
alice (Support): Sorry to hear that, Ben. Can you paste the exact 401 response body and the request header you used? Also did you create the key via Console or API?
ben.jones (Acme): Created via Console. Here's the curl we run in CI (sanitized):

```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer SK_live_abc123..." 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"input": "test"}' 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

Response (truncated):
```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
content-type: application/json

{"error":{"type":"invalid_api_key","message":"Invalid API key"}}
```

I rotated the key in Console and updated CI secret, but still 401.
alice (Support): Okay — a few possibilities: (1) CI secret has trailing newline or invisible char, (2) rotated key not actually active yet, (3) wrong environment (staging vs prod) key. Can you run `echo -n "$KEY" | wc -c` in CI or paste the first/last 6 chars of the key? Don’t paste full key.
ben.jones (Acme): First/last chars: SK_live_abc123 ... xyz789. Running `echo -n` shows length 32, which matches what we expect. No obvious newline.

I also tried pasting the key locally into curl and still get 401.
alice (Support): Thanks. @chandra do you want to check key state from our side? I can escalate to internal tooling.
chandra (SRE): Looking now — querying key metadata with internal admin tool. Can you confirm the account org id and the display name of the key? We saw some keys imported from SSO vault with a policy that forces rotation, might be marked disabled.
ben.jones (Acme): Org id: org_98765. Key display name: "acme-ci-02". Created 2026-03-15 09:05 UTC.
chandra (SRE): I see an entry for that name but the internal record shows status: disabled and last_used: null. Also created_by: SSO-integ (ok). Possibly the key was created but not activated due to an SSO policy requiring manual approval.
chandra (SRE): Running enable action now...
api-monitor-bot: action=key_enable user=chandra target=key_acme_ci_02 ts=2026-03-15T09:18:05Z status=ok
chandra (SRE): Enabled the key. Please retry.
ben.jones (Acme): Retrying now... still 401. Response body same.
alice (Support): Hmm. Two checks: (A) Are you hitting the correct hostname for the region? Keys are bound to region in some private deployments. (B) Could the key in CI have been copied with an invisible zero-width space or non-ASCII char? Try running `printf "%s" "$KEY" | hexdump -C | sed -n '1,2p'` and paste output.
ben.jones (Acme): Hex dump: `00000000  53 4b 5f 6c 69 76 65 5f 61 62 63 31 32 33 20 0a` — oh wow there's `20 0a` at the end (space + newline). How did that get in there. CI secrets editor trimmed but paste added newline.
alice (Support): That explains it — trailing space/newline will change the token. Two options: strip whitespace in CI or re-enter the key. Also rotate the old key and create a new one if you think it was leaked in logs.
ben.jones (Acme): We stripped it and updated CI, jobs now passing. Thanks!

A couple follow-ups: can we make Console validation warn if key paste contains whitespace? And any way to have a short-lived activation delay message if SSO policy holds keys disabled?
alice (Support): Noted — I'll open a feature request for paste validation. For SSO/auto-approve policies, that's an admin setting — we can add clearer UI state for "awaiting admin approval". I'll file internal ticket and ping product.
nora (Billing): Noticed you mentioned rotation — just flagging that rotating keys doesn't affect billing but if you create new keys repeatedly it can clutter org logs; we can help clean up old keys if you want.
ben.jones (Acme): Appreciate it. Please close once the feature request is tracked. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
alice (Support): Closing summary: root cause = trailing whitespace/newline in CI-secret causing 401 invalid_api_key. Secondary note = key was briefly disabled by SSO policy but enabling didn't fix until key was updated. Actions: educate customer on trimming, file UI validation FR, and add doc blurb about SSO key activation. Marking resolved.
